anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/final recommended=1

This PR adds an Export CSV button to the reports page that downloads every column shown in the table, with paging capped at 100 rows per page and a 4-second deadline, and it returns "not found" for unknown reports. Emailed exports and audit-log events are deferred to acme/widgets#46 as the spec says, and the paging limits that keep exports short are in place and tested, but whether exports finish under five seconds on real production data can only be checked after merge.

Nothing blocks merging: the test check passed in CI on the commit being reviewed, and the description's statement that it adds tests for the CSV handler matches the new tests. You are the author, so you cannot approve your own PR. One smaller point does not block merging: the export handler pages through rows with its own loop instead of reusing the shared paging helper (src/api/export.ts, line 31). The fix nits option can take it.

I recommend merge because nothing blocks it and the checks passed on this commit.

Pick one:
1. merge - squash-merge the PR at the commit being reviewed. [recommended]
2. fix nits - switch the export to the shared paging helper, review the change, push it, and watch the checks once before offering merge again.
3. stop - leave the PR open and the checkout as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
